title: A rare-earths name has a +363% target, Frontline is up 31%, and SanJuan rose 12.6% today
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Commodities and related names were a mixed bag. Today's write-ups  
highlight a rare-earths price target implying +363% upside, a 31%  
30-day move in Frontline, and a 12.6% gain in San Juan today.  
  
Here is the rundown. Price targets are targets, not promises.  
  
\*\*1. Rare Earths Americas (REA)\*\* — The $26 central target is the  
arithmetic mean of five individually verified analyst price targets:  
$12, $25, $28, $30 and $34. At a recent price of about $5.62, reaching  
$26 would require roughly 363% upside — a very large move. Target, not  
a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/rare-earths-americas-rea-exploring-the-path-to-a-26-analyst-target-363-upside-38471/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/rare-earths-americas-rea-exploring-the-path-to-a-26-analyst-target-363-upside-38471/)  
  
\*\*2. Frontline (FRO)\*\* — The $61.50 target used here is the average of  
the two verified analyst price targets that sit above the current  
price: Evercore ISI's $53 and BTIG's $70. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/frontline-plc-fro-is-31-upside-to-61-50-still-in-reach-38479/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/frontline-plc-fro-is-31-upside-to-61-50-still-in-reach-38479/)  
  
\*\*3. San Juan Basin Royalty Trust (SJT)\*\* — SJT jumped +12.63%, or  
\+$0.50, from Friday's close of $3.96 to $4.46 in Monday's regular  
session (3:07 p.m. ET), recovering part of Friday's -8.76% slide. No  
verified news or fundamental catalyst found: no trust release, filing  
or analyst action surfaced Monday.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-san-juan-basin-royalty-trust-sjt-stock-up-12-63-today-39135/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-san-juan-basin-royalty-trust-sjt-stock-up-12-63-today-39135/)  
  
\*\*4. i-80 Gold (IAUX)\*\* — The central stock price target of $3.25 is  
the arithmetic mean of two verified, current 12-month analyst price  
targets, rounded from $3.24. Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/i-80-gold-iaux-152-upside-to-3-25-analyst-target-38521/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/i-80-gold-iaux-152-upside-to-3-25-analyst-target-38521/)  
  
\*\*5. MPC vs PBF\*\* — Scale and Stability in the Refining Cycle. Two  
setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead? The breakdown is  
in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/marathon-petroleum-mpc-vs-pbf-energy-pbf-scale-and-stability-in-the-refining-cycle-38550/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/marathon-petroleum-mpc-vs-pbf-energy-pbf-scale-and-stability-in-the-refining-cycle-38550/)  
  
\*\*6. HAL vs OXY\*\* — Contrasting Services and Production Plays in  
Energy. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes out ahead? The  
breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/hal-vs-oxy-contrasting-services-and-production-plays-in-energy-38503/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/hal-vs-oxy-contrasting-services-and-production-plays-in-energy-38503/)  
  
\*\*7. IAU vs OUNZ\*\* — Weighing Liquidity Against Physical Delivery  
Options in Gold ETFs. Two setups, one head-to-head. Which one comes  
out ahead? The breakdown is in the link.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/iau-vs-ounz-weighing-liquidity-against-physical-delivery-options-in-gold-etfs-38508/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/iau-vs-ounz-weighing-liquidity-against-physical-delivery-options-in-gold-etfs-38508/)  
  
Which of these commodity trades are you actually following, and which  
targets look too aggressive?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 16) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
